name: Ane to Ore wa Naka ga Ii
source:
Sister is a little awkward and she loves to watch her little brothers troubled face.
Sharing the same room for a long time but, something changed...
Her naught mischief is triggerd.
'' I would be suspected, but it's not that rough for siblings is it?''
Altough immediately said it and the misunderstanding solved.
My sister dispel the suspicion...

How will our relationship continue..?
translation:
姐姐有点笨拙，她喜欢看弟弟困扰的表情。共处一室已经很久了，但有什么东西改变了……她的恶作剧因子被触发了。“虽然会被怀疑，但姐弟之间这样也不算太过分吧？”虽然立刻就这么说了，误会也解除了。姐姐消除了嫌疑……

我们的关系将何去何从……？
